title: Deeper/broader peer failure modes and semantic checkpoints
mode: primary-source web research and plan refinement
scope: Review current ACadSharp reports for silent record disappearance, field-default, and transform-semantic failure modes
Reconcile current LibreDWG, ezdxf, and FreeCAD ACIS/AcDs route limitations
Convert peer reports into an implementation-ready, stage-specific semantic checklist without promoting them to local defects

method.kind: Read current primary project documentation and issue reports; reconcile with the local parity plan
method.limitations: GitHub project sources are mutable; issue reports are peer-specific maintainer/user reports rather than normative format evidence or local reproductions. The ACadSharp INSERT report has no public source sample and includes a possible base-type/count confound. No peer behavior was executed.

sources.project: ACadSharp INSERT/record-disposition report and capability matrix
sources.revision: Mutable issue/index reviewed 2026-10-18; issue #1172 opened 2026-07-31 and still open at review
sources.observed: Issue #1172 reports silent loss of some INSERT-derived records in an AC1032 read/write/read route. The source drawings are private and the maintainer requested a minimal sample. A later comment notes TableEntity inherits Insert and may confound the reported type count; the reported root cause remains unresolved. The README matrix identifies reader/writer/version routes but does not establish per-record preservation.

The report states that one AutoCAD-authored drawing yields zero LEADER TextWidth/TextHeight in ACadSharp 3.6.51 and group 41 zero in DXF, with downstream hook geometry omitted. The drawing is not attached; this is not an independently validated format rule or libdxfrw result.

The author reports a sign/orientation error for rotated ARC start/end angles and stale ELLIPSE rotation in ApplyTransform, despite a correctly moved ARC center, on the named ACadSharp source/release. It is a peer geometry-operation report, not evidence of a DWG byte-layout defect.

sources.project: LibreDWG ACIS/AcDs loss report and project notes
sources.revision: Issue opened 2026-09-02 and mutable NEWS reviewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: Issue #1411 reports one LibreDWG 0.14.8593 route losing AcDs/SAB data for an ezdxf-generated AC1032 REGION while the entity survives. NEWS describes incomplete AcDsPrototype_1b handling. This is a peer-specific negative report, not a positive semantic oracle or universal current-release result.

sources.project: ezdxf ACIS scope and FreeCAD consumer scope
sources.revision: ezdxf stable docs and archived FreeCAD documentation repository reviewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: ezdxf documents limited ACIS structure support and unsupported-node handling rather than a general solid kernel. FreeCAD documentation distinguishes its incomplete native and optional legacy DXF import routes, states stock FreeCAD cannot read ACIS solids, and describes DWG conversion as external; the stock consumer route does not establish ACIS solid support.

assessment.planImpact: Adds a touched-family/composed-checkpoint semantic checklist: distinguish record identity and owner membership, discriminating scalar/geometry fields, writer closure, diagnostics, and independent reopen/consumer results. Keeps peer issue reports as advisory failure-mode leads; does not create local findings or require new external runs. ACIS opaque carrier, AcDs association, parse, topology, and native acceptance remain separate evidence rows.

implementationReadyChecks: Treat peer issues without an eligible reproducible artifact as LEAD_ONLY; do not infer local defects or format rules from the report.
For record survival, distinguish concrete runtime types from base-class counts and compare handles, owners, layout/block membership, linked children, and diagnostics.
For fields that affect drawing, compare source value, parsed value, emitted DXF/DWG value, and an independent geometry/consumer result where applicable.
For geometry transforms, test asymmetric generated ARC/ELLIPSE cases and orientation/frame values; correct centers/extents alone are insufficient.
For ACIS, report raw SAT/SAB, AcDs association, parsed representation, topology/analytic validity, and native application behavior independently.
Add no peer, native, sanitizer, broad corpus, full-suite, persistent external fixture, or dependency work to leaf slices; retain existing focused selector and owning CTest cadence.
Keep plan totals 130 findings / 73 top-level subplans and J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, J295 DEFERRED_EXTERNAL.
